answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and registers a vine post. Thrice per epoch a flare summons all at random; each must echo its code in ten minutes, with an onyx stamp and yarrow serial. A missed echo slashes 35; a second burns the bond. Staffing 1,000 fakes costs 70,000 in bonds plus 150,000 in fees against a 40,000 pool; a hired echo fails since each echo is key-signed to its post. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its full share.
